title: 第3章 侥幸不死第4章 天才还是废柴
slug: 凡人修仙开局看守草药场
content_zh:
苏星河睁开眼时，天已大亮，胸口处的重压，导致呼吸困难，片刻的茫然，这才回想起先前的一切。
“爷爷！”苏星河浑身剧痛，使出全身的力气，将趴伏在自己胸口的老村长扶起，自己也简单的坐起身。
伸手一探，老村长早已没了鼻息，苏星河怔怔的看着眼前的老人，灰白的长发散乱，血污遍布纵横沟壑的皱纹，原本的慈祥被狰狞取代，他死时定然是痛苦万分。
想起这些年与爷爷相依为命的点点滴滴，不觉间已是满脸泪水，再看到满地村民的尸体，更是一股悲凉涌上心头，一起涌起的还有满腔的杀意！
“玄冥师叔！”苏星河想起昏厥前，年轻仙师是这样称呼凶手的，他要将这个名字牢牢记在心里，总有一天要为爷爷和全村人报仇雪恨！
可是，那可是仙人啊，挥一挥手，就可杀死所有人，像碾死蝼蚁一样简单，想到此，苏星河满是绝望。
“我还有灵器瓷瓶！”苏星河察觉到神识中，翠绿的瓷瓶依旧凌空悬停，原本空荡荡的瓷瓶，此时又萦绕了些许白雾。
正想要初级白雾，获取力量，忽然想起两位仙师的觊觎，连忙打消想法，随着意识的退出，一切仿佛没有发生过，看来自己能够侥幸不死，除了爷爷的奋不顾身，更主要的是这瓷瓶暗藏的力量，帮我抵御了对方的杀招。
安葬了爷爷，苏星河在满地的尸体中寻找，他要找到虎子的尸体进行安葬，整个村子里，虎子是他最好的朋友，也是唯一能够交心的朋友。
在一块巨石后，虎子蜷缩成一团，他的怀里抱着一个女人，正是他的娘亲，两人相依为命，临死也是互相依偎，看到这场景，苏星河不觉又红了眼睛，对两位凶手的憎恨，不觉又加深了几分。
“啊~”刚被苏星河抱起的虎子身体轻轻一震，同时发出了一声痛苦的惨嚎。
苏星河大喜，连忙将虎子轻轻放下，伸手去探他鼻息，果然，还有微弱的气息，虎子没死！
“虎子！虎子！”苏星河惊喜万分。
“星河~”虎子睁开眼，一片茫然，与先前苏星河如出一辙，只是他受伤更重，连开口说话都显得十分困难。
“太好了，你没事！”苏星河伸手去搀扶虎子，还未坐定，却见他嘴角又有鲜血渗出，沿着下巴，一直流到脖颈，神情委顿至极，仿佛一口气上不来，就要再次晕厥。
苏星河没料到，以虎子强劲的体魄，竟然比自己受伤还重，略一想，定然是灵器瓷瓶的原因，否则，以自己这算不上强壮的身体，早就死透了。
“娘！我娘怎么样了！”稍微缓过气来的虎子，就挣扎着朝他娘亲爬去，这一动，似乎又牵扯到了内伤，嘴角鲜血再次溢出。
“虎子，婶婶已经不在了，活着的只有我们两人！”说话时，苏星河看着天空中，昨天凶手停留的位置。
闻言，虎子面色一白，险些栽倒，苏星河连忙上前将其扶住，轻轻拍打他的胸膛，为他疏散体内郁气，本想试试瓷瓶中的力量是否可以调动，渡送到虎子体内，一来不知使用法门，二又怕再次引来凶手的察觉，只得作罢。
“虎子，你先休息片刻，我去将婶婶安葬！咱们必须尽快离开，以防凶手再次到来！”苏星河虽说不懂尔虞我诈，却从小读书，心思比起虎子，要缜密的多。

虎子点头，却没继续休息，挣扎着爬起身，与苏星河一起，将娘亲埋葬。
冷风呼啸，崎岖的山路中，两个少年搀扶而行，跌跌撞撞，步履蹒跚。
“星河，我们这是去哪？”说是两人互相搀扶，其实大半都是苏星河架着虎子。
“去镇上！”苏星河气喘吁吁，说话困难。
“为什么要去镇上，我们的村子不要了吗？”虎子不舍的回头张望。
“没有了亲人，留在村子里还有什么意义，更何况，我们并不一定真的安全，那两个该死的家伙，既然是寻找宝物，没到手之前，一定会反复寻找，如果被察觉到我们还活着，那就真的没希望了！”苏星河目光坚毅，毫不犹豫。
“什么宝物，竟然要杀了我们所有人！”虎子眼眶通红，还沉浸在失去亲人的痛苦之中。
“什么宝物不重要，杀人，不过是当我们是蝼蚁！你想想，如果让你捏死蝼蚁，你会在乎吗？”苏星河没有将自己得到瓷瓶的事情说出来，并不是怕虎子会泄露，只是担心虎子心思单纯，万一遇到突发情况，露出马脚。
“我要为我娘报仇！为全村人报仇！”虎子似乎也下定决心，只是下一刻，又气馁道：“星河，那俩人是仙人吧？我们怎么能跟仙人对抗？”
“狗屁的仙人！修了点杀人本事而已，他可以修，我们也可以修仙！”若换成以前，苏星河不敢这么想，但现在不同了，自己有了灵器瓷瓶，虽然不清楚这瓷瓶真正得价值，但只是泄露了灵气，就引来他们的觊觎，一定是好东西，等将来研究透了，或许也可以修仙，修成更强大的仙人！
“星河，你好像跟以前不一样了！”看着眼前有些陌生的苏星河，虎子有些担忧。
“当然！我要变强，强到可以随手碾死他们！”
“可是，我们连凶手是谁都还不清楚！”虎子有些泄气。
content_en:
When Su Xinghe opened his eyes, it was already bright. The heavy pressure on his chest made it difficult to breathe. He was confused for a moment before he recalled everything before.
"Grandpa!" Su Xinghe felt severe pain all over his body. He used all his strength to lift up the old village chief who was lying on his chest, and then he simply sat up.
Reaching out to check, the old village chief had long since stopped breathing. Su Xinghe stared blankly at the old man in front of him. His long gray hair was disheveled, and blood stains covered the wrinkles in the ravines. His original kindness was replaced by ferocity. He must have been in great pain when he died.
Thinking of all these years of living together with my grandfather, my face was filled with tears before I knew it. When I saw the corpses of villagers on the ground, a feeling of sadness filled my heart, along with the murderous intention!
"Uncle Xuanming!" Su Xinghe remembered what the young immortal master called the murderer before he fainted. He wanted to keep this name firmly in his heart, and one day he would avenge his grandfather and the whole village!
However, that was an immortal. With a wave of his hand, he could kill everyone as easily as crushing ants. Thinking of this, Su Xinghe was filled with despair.
"I still have a spiritual artifact porcelain bottle!" Su Xinghe noticed in his consciousness that the emerald green porcelain bottle was still hovering in the air. The originally empty porcelain bottle was now surrounded by some white mist.
I was about to get the primary white mist and gain power when I suddenly remembered the covetousness of the two immortal masters. I quickly gave up the idea. With the withdrawal of consciousness, everything seemed to have never happened. It seemed that I was able to survive. In addition to my grandfather's desperate efforts, more importantly, the power hidden in this porcelain bottle helped me resist the other party's killing move.
After burying his grandfather, Su Xinghe searched among the corpses on the ground. He wanted to find Huzi's body for burial. In the whole village, Huzi was his best friend and the only friend he could be close to.
Behind a huge boulder, Huzi huddled up in a ball, holding a woman in his arms, who was his mother. The two depended on each other for life, and even when dying, Su Xinghe's eyes turned red again, and his hatred for the two murderers deepened.
"Ah~" Huzi's body shook slightly as he was just picked up by Su Xinghe, and he let out a painful howl at the same time.
Su Xinghe was overjoyed, and quickly put Huzi down gently, reaching out to detect his breath. Sure enough, there was still a faint breath, Huzi was not dead!
"Huzi! Huzi!" Su Xinghe was extremely surprised.
"Xinghe~" Huzi opened his eyes and was at a loss. He was exactly the same as Su Xinghe before, except that he was more seriously injured and it was very difficult to even speak.
"Great, you're okay!" Su Xinghe reached out to help Huzi. Before he could sit down, he saw blood oozing from the corner of his mouth, flowing along his chin and all the way to his neck. He looked extremely tired, as if he couldn't breathe and was about to faint again.
Su Xinghe didn't expect that Huzi's strong body would actually hurt him more seriously than himself. After thinking about it, it must be the cause of the spiritual artifact porcelain vase. Otherwise, with his not-so-strong body, he would have died long ago.
"Mom! How is my mother!" Huzi, who had regained his breath a little, struggled to crawl towards his mother. This movement seemed to involve internal injuries, and blood spilled out of the corner of his mouth again.
"Huzi, my aunt is gone, only the two of us are alive!" While speaking, Su Xinghe looked at the sky where the murderer stayed yesterday.
Hearing this, Hu Zi's face turned pale and he almost fell down. Su Xinghe quickly stepped forward to support him and gently tapped his chest to disperse the stagnation in his body. He originally wanted to test whether the power in the porcelain bottle could be mobilized and transferred to Hu Zi's body, but he didn't know how to use it and was afraid of attracting the murderer's attention again, so he had to give up.
"Huzi, you rest for a while, I will bury aunt! We must leave as soon as possible to prevent the murderer from coming again!" Although Su Xinghe did not understand intrigues, he had studied since he was a child, and his thoughts were much more thoughtful than Huzi's.
Huzi nodded, but did not continue to rest. He struggled to get up.body, together with Su Xinghe, buried her mother.
The cold wind howled, and on the rugged mountain road, two teenagers walked with support, stumbling and faltering.
"Xinghe, where are we going?" It was said that the two of them were supporting each other, but in fact, it was mostly Su Xinghe who was holding the bag.
"Go to town!" Su Xinghe was panting and had difficulty speaking.
"Why do you want to go to town? Don't you want our village?" Huzi looked back reluctantly.
"Without our relatives, what's the point of staying in the village? What's more, we are not necessarily safe. Since those two damn guys are looking for treasures, they will definitely search again and again before they get it. If it is discovered that we are still alive, there is really no hope!" Su Xinghe's eyes were firm and he did not hesitate.
"What treasure is going to kill all of us!" Huzi's eyes were red, still immersed in the pain of losing his loved ones.
"It doesn't matter what the treasure is. Killing people is just treating us as ants! Think about it, if you were asked to crush the ants to death, would you care?" Su Xinghe did not tell the story of getting the porcelain bottle. It was not because he was afraid that Huzi would reveal it, but because he was worried that Huzi was simple-minded and would be exposed in case of an unexpected situation.
"I want to avenge my mother! I want to avenge the whole village!" Huzi seemed to be determined, but the next moment, he got discouraged and said: "Xinghe, those two are immortals, right? How can we fight against the immortals?"
"Bullshit immortal! He just cultivated some killing skills. If he can cultivate it, we can cultivate immortality too!" In the past, Su Xinghe would not have dared to think so, but now it is different. He has a spiritual artifact porcelain vase. Although he does not know the true value of this porcelain vase, it only leaks spiritual energy and attracts their covetousness. It must be a good thing. After thorough research in the future, he may also be able to cultivate immortality and become a more powerful immortal!
"Xinghe, you seem to be different from before!" Looking at the unfamiliar Su Xinghe in front of him, Huzi was a little worried.
"Of course! I want to become stronger, strong enough to crush them with ease!"
"But, we don't even know who the murderer is!" Huzi was a little discouraged.
